metadata.description: A deep-dive bilingual word mastery tool for adults. It deconstructs a single word (English or Chinese) into its original image, core metaphor, boundaries, lived scene, bilingual epiphany, and retrieval challenge, outputting two parallel native versions — one Chinese, one English.
